action_items: None required - all spec items verified. Two small fixes were applied by the tester (see updated_files) and should be reviewed/merged.
critical_code_review_comments: MerchantHome.copy(): navigator.clipboard.writeText returns a Promise; the original code fired it without .catch, causing an UnhandledPromiseRejection ('Write permission denied') that surfaced as a webpack-dev-server overlay iframe intercepting pointer events in test/preview envs. Wrap in try/catch + .catch(() => {}) so the toast fires regardless of clipboard permission. Fix applied.

DispatchTimeline SRC map was missing the 'admin_ring' key, so admin-initiated single-partner re-rings showed the raw slug 'admin_ring' next to 'Rung <partner>' both in the chronology and in Lane badges. Added admin_ring: 'Admin rang again' per spec. Fix applied.
MerchantDashboard.jsx is 269 lines and OK, but MerchantHome + BookForCustomer + OnboardPartner sub-components in the same file could be split for consistency with how CustomerHome was extracted.
PanelLayout.jsx primary-tabs filtering in the More sheet works correctly (customer sheet excludes home/orders/wallet/profile) — this addresses the previous iteration's cosmetic finding.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Redesign fully verified across merchant/customer/admin at both 390x844 and 1920x1080. Two small resiliency fixes were applied (clipboard write guard + admin_ring label). Clipboard error only reproduces without granted clipboard-write permission - tests should call page.context.grant_permissions(['clipboard-read','clipboard-write'], origin=<base>) to keep interaction clean. No horizontal overflow anywhere. No console errors on any screen after fixes.
rca_of_the_issue: 1) Clipboard: navigator.clipboard.writeText rejects when the tab lacks user gesture / permission (common in preview/iframe/hidden tab). The unhandled rejection was surfaced by react-dev overlay via an iframe with pointer-events: auto covering the viewport, which then blocked subsequent Playwright clicks on mh-book/mh-add-partner. Wrapping the call with try/catch + optional-chained .catch prevents the overlay. 2) Admin ring label: the SRC lookup table simply did not include the 'admin_ring' key emitted by the /api/admin/bookings/{id}/dispatch-timeline endpoint, so it fell through to the raw slug.
